title: Renormalization, equipotential annuli and the Hausdorff measure
summary: For a complex single variable polynomial $f$ of degree $d$, let $K$ be its filled Julia set, i.e., the union of all bounded orbits. Assume that $K$ has an invariant component $K^*$ on which $f$ acts as a degree $d_*<d$ map. This is a simplest instance of holomorphic polynomial-like renormalization (Douady-Hubbard). One can associate a certain Cantor-like subset $G'$ of the circle with $K^*$; it is defined as the set of arguments of all smooth or broken rays to $K^*$. We will describe a role the Hausdorff dimension of $G'$ and the respective Hausdorff measure play in geometry of $K^*$. In…
